migrations.description: Add dependsOn pull-image to the dev target of ts#dynamodb and ts#rdb projects
migrations.name: latest-dev-target-depends-on-pull-image

migrations.description: Switch generated OpenAPI codegen targets to the in-process open-api-codegen executor
migrations.name: latest-open-api-codegen-executor

migrations.description: Share Terraform provider downloads across terraform init targets via TF_PLUGIN_CACHE_DIR
migrations.name: latest-terraform-provider-plugin-cache

migrations.description: Exclude Python test files from the production named input and scope dependent task outputs to dist so Python test edits do not invalidate build tasks
migrations.name: latest-python-test-input-scoping

migrations.description: Write vitest coverage reports to the project's dist directory rather than inside the project
migrations.name: latest-vitest-coverage-output-dir

migrations.description: Add an assemble target as the artifact-only sibling of build, point the deploy targets at it, and narrow compile targets depending on ^build to ^compile
migrations.name: latest-add-assemble-target

migrations.description: Make container image build and scan targets non-cacheable, so a cache hit can never report success for an image the container engine no longer has
migrations.name: latest-docker-target-cache-soundness

migrations.description: Declare explicit inputs on cacheable bundle, openapi, operations and checkov targets so they no longer read a dependency's whole project directory through Nx's implicit inputs
migrations.name: latest-declare-cacheable-target-inputs

migrations.description: Make the terraform fmt target check formatting rather than rewrite its own inputs, moving the write to a fix configuration, and add a lint target which orchestrates it
migrations.name: latest-terraform-fmt-check

migrations.description: Assign each react-website project its own dev-server and preview port, and allow-list them for any connected Cognito auth
migrations.name: latest-react-website-unique-dev-ports

migrations.description: Sync vended dependency versions and the tracked plugin version to those vended by this release
migrations.name: sync-vended-versions
